name: 3-Block Littlestone Dimension of Warmuth's $C_5$ Class
proof: VC dimension two gives a depth-two level-constant tree. A depth-three 3-block tree has all three levels horizontally constant, so it would shatter three fixed coordinates, contradicting VC dimension two.
references: Directly from the block-tree definition and the $C_5$ VC calculation in \cite{palvolgyi2021unlabeled}.
